headline: Week 14: The Cocks Came Out Swinging and Everyone Else Got Slapped
subhead: Six matchups, five blowouts, and one Largest of Rocks coaching crime that should be investigated by the league office.
matchOfTheWeek: The Olave Garden squeaked past LargestofRocks 159.96 to 154.60 in the only game that didn't feel like a public execution. Puka Nacua dropped 41.8 to keep Patrickreegs alive, while LargestofRocks left a buffet of 28.86 points rotting on the bench — including Drew Lock's 15.98 and Quentin Johnston's 15.80. Sam Darnold goes for 34.58 and you still find a way to lose by five because you started the wrong half of your roster.
powerRankingsShakeup: Hot Cocks just dropped a 190-burger and announced themselves as the team nobody wants to see in round one. Stroud Boys and T swift's Baddies are in free-fall — 173 and 190 dropped on their heads in the same week is not a coincidence, that's a diagnosis.
mainRecap:
Hot Cocks put up 190.42 and made T swift's Baddies look like a JV scrimmage. Ja'Marr Chase 45.1, Tyreek Hill 28.1 — BigD didn't just win, he sent a 50-point ransom note to the rest of the bracket. Tnicolle, 140 isn't bad, it just doesn't matter when the other guy is auditioning for a Madden cover.

The Good Ladds rode Josh Allen's 51.88-point monster game to a 173.74 demolition of Stroud Boys. Bjewett, your team is named Stroud Boys and you got cooked by a guy who started Isaac Guerendo. Read that sentence again. Allen threw for 4 TDs and ran for 2 and Mig was just along for the ride hitting refresh and giggling.

Put an AR to My Head dumped 164 on Jets' Juniors, who managed the league-low 117.60 for the second-worst showing of the night. Wunder, your starting lineup got out-scored by Kyle's bench WR — Jalen McMillan went for 21.9 in street clothes. That's not a fantasy team, that's a participation trophy with a logo.

226 Alpha handled MassiveCocks 165 to 130, though szara left Matthew Stafford's 20.8 on the pine because apparently we're not playing to win championships, we're playing to feel things. Still, a W is a W when 7BigPapi rolls out a 130-spot.

Bo Nix Celli quietly ran 98.7% lineup efficiency — the cleanest start/sit job of the week — and beat OnlyFants 135 to 117 behind Zach Charbonnet's 38.3. Cubby got 32 from Jefferson and still lost, which is the OnlyFants brand at this point: pay the premium, get the disappointment.

weeklyAwards.title: Scoreboard Arsonist
weeklyAwards.blurb: 190.42 is not a score, it's a felony — Chase and Hill turned BigD's matchup into a crime scene.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Coach of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Lost by 5.36 with 28.86 points stapled to the bench — Drew Lock and Quentin Johnston watched the L from the sideline like everyone else.

weeklyAwards.title: Why Are You Here Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: 117.60 points and a 46-point loss — Wunder's lineup looked like it was filled out by a taxi squad with the flu.

weeklyAwards.title: Cardiac Garden
weeklyAwards.blurb: Puka's 41.8 bailed out a roster that left Juwan Johnson's 17 on the bench — survived a coin flip and called it a win.
